purpose: Fixed-mechanism exploratory comparisons retained as future work; only green_median_full selected for production.

selection_stages.selection: All eight modes and paper baseline evaluated on complete442-image original corpus
Every16th image independently within each dataset,31total; mechanisms frozen before scoring
Complete selected-model evaluation; CPU/CUDA byte pairing; oldsource and independent scalar-output verification

selection_caveat: Selection and final reporting reuse the same benchmark corpus. These are development results, not an independent held-out test.

root_modes.initial_soft: Initial immutable chroma median; green remains unchanged.
root_modes.green_median_full: At chromatic sites set clipped G=Cmeasured-median(C-G), then reconstruct missing other color using this refined G plus its median chroma.
root_modes.green_median_half: Half of full median-derived green correction; reconstruct missing other color from refined G.
root_modes.green_median_quarter: Quarter of full median-derived green correction; reconstruct missing other color from refined G.
root_modes.green_only_full: Full green correction, but reconstruct missing other color using original G.
root_modes.green_only_half: Half green correction, but reconstruct missing other color using original G.
root_modes.green_median_clip8: Limit full green correction to plus/minus8 DN; reconstruct other color using refined G.
root_modes.green_median_gate16: Apply full green correction only if its absolute size is <=16 DN; reconstruct other color using refined G.

rb_soft.description: Inverse diagonal chroma-gradient weighting, one nearest rounding

rb_four.description: Equal four-diagonal chroma average, one nearest rounding

rb_round_once.description: Native diagonal decision; close directions rounded once from four samples

rb_hard.description: Hard lower-gradient diagonal selection without close averaging

rb_soft_green_gradient.description: Soft diagonal weighting by chroma and green gradients

rb_soft_regularized.description: Soft diagonal weighting with 8DN denominator regularizer

median_half.description: Half native median and half original chroma

median_threequarters.description: Three quarters native median and quarter original chroma

median_opposite_only.description: Apply native median only to opposite color at chromatic sites

median_green_sites_only.description: Apply native median only at measured green sites

median_limit8.description: Limit native median chroma correction to eight DN

native.description: Exact initial SoftMenon green candidate/score/linear blend control

single_round_candidates.description: Replace two separately rounded HA candidate terms by one signed nearest rounded sum; native scores recomputed from these candidates

native_squared_weights.description: Square native crossed inverse-score weights; candidate/score formulas unchanged

ha_linear_weights.description: Replace score by abs(Gleft-Gright)+abs(2*C-Cleft2-Cright2); same initial candidates and linear inverse weights

ha_squared_weights.description: Hamilton-Adams score with squared inverse weights

colocated_linear_weights.description: Score = abs((C-Gh)center-(C-Gh)left2)+abs((C-Gh)center-(C-Gh)right2), using separately rounded native candidates at each site; vertical analogue

colocated_squared_weights.description: Colocated color-difference score with squared inverse weights

native_plus_colocated.description: Add native and colocated scores then use linear inverse weights

green_gradient_linear_weights.description: Score only abs(GL-GR), vertical counterpart; retain HA candidates and linear inverse weights

posterior_linear_weights.description: Paper eight-tap posterior classifier stencil on native rounded directional candidates; linear inverse weights; reflected RAW extension, no paper zero gradient halo

posterior_squared_weights.description: Same local posterior classifier with squared inverse weights

frozen.scope: Quality only; scalar prototype timing is not production speed. Stored rendered RGB remosaiced without resizing or inverse gamma.

recommendation: Preserve posterior/colocated classifier, one-round green, diagonal weighting, median alternatives for later investigation; none added to the selected production algorithm.
root_reference_dependency_note: The postprocessor uses only median9 from the frozen initial header; the baseline is separately hash-pinned. The root reference shared library is a local historical build, not a shipped binary.
